items.name: Foreach Loop
items.description: Write a foreach loop that iterates over a list with any name.
items.feedback: Syntax: foreach (var item in collection) - don't forget the 'var', 'in', and parentheses.
items.successFeedback: Tip: always include curly braces, even for one-line bodies.

items.name: For Loop
items.description: Write a for loop that counts from 0 to 9.
items.feedback: Remember: initialization (int i = 0), condition (i < 10), and increment (i++).

items.name: If Statement
items.description: Write an if statement that checks if a variable 'x' is greater than 5.
